records.description: M365 Conditional Access zero-coverage baseline: every new customer tenant expected to have zero CA policies. ROOT CAUSE EXPANDED (Sept 2): SMB tenants typically have Security Defaults ON, which (a) masks the zero-CA finding severity (baseline covered) and (b) hard-blocks CA enforcement (mutually exclusive — HTTP 400). Standard heal now: deploy 3-policy baseline report-only → disable SD via PATCH identitySecurityDefaultsEnforcementPolicy (works under 10-role least-privilege token) → enforce all 3 policies in the same window → verify post-replication. Severity matrix: SD on + zero CA = Medium (baseline covered); SD off + zero CA = Critical (naked). 3 live executions on SquirlOSTechnologies tenant, all successful (HE-M365-CA-001/002/003).
records.name: M365 Conditional Access Baseline Pattern
records.common_root_causes: New tenant defaults; SMB admins never configure CA; Security Defaults silently blocking enforcement
